content: Yɛsu kusà a Pilatu
U tutu tutu, amfum a angaŋ bàköŋ anà andweer, anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà Làbay a nsaŋ làkölàköl lanswà. Ba bàbäm Yɛsu in'siŋ, bun'syen anà bun'pɛ akà Pilatu.
Pilatu waa kun'fuul naa: « Nkye ngye awà mfum a Ayudà? » Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: « Ngye ŋàkwo an'tɛn. »
Amfum a angaŋ bun'füünà indiir mbɔɔn.
Pilatu kàfun'fuulà naa: « Nkye ngye ndaa afuur anki akà ikikye? Ngye akiweemà indiir mbɔɔn bàfüünà ba ngye! »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsàfuur anki akà ndaa mwɛy, abun Pilatu waa kàbem.
Yɛsu bàmutsüül mbar a ukwà
Kà un'kyɔm wanswà, Pilatu kàkäl anà nkääl mutsuuŋ mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy, mbuur kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà un'sɛŋ.
Kyekà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Barabas kàkäl u bɔlokà anà aŋàlingyoomà abà bàdwä mbuur umpal làbü lingyoomà.
Un'sɛŋ a baar kàbeenà, waa kàsɛmà mukun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa nde kapɛ asànaa nkääl ande.
Pilatu kàfuul naa: « Nkye bɛ làkyàkwen mɛ alàwɛɛy mfum a Ayudà? »
Ntɔn nde kàkyer ayöb naa ba Yɛsu bun'yälà ntɔn un'köl aba.
Wɛɛ amfum a angaŋ bàsiinà un'sɛŋ ntɔn Pilatu katsuuŋ awà Barabas.
Pilatu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: « Abun bɛ làkwen naa mɛ nkye in'kyer anà mbuur làfàbel bɛ mfum a Ayudà? »
Ba bàfàsà in'kwɛŋ: « Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! »
Pilatu kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: « Ube nà nde kàkyer bà? » Wɛɛ ba bàsöönà musà in'kwɛŋ: « Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! »
Pilatu kàkwen mupà un'sɛŋ un'sak, waa katsuuŋ Barabas. Apan nde kàswɛŋ naa bàkäm Yɛsu an'füm, waa kun'yälà ntɔn bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Aŋità bàmusɛɛ Yɛsu
Aŋità bàsyen Yɛsu uboo a làpaŋ a kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r u pɛlàtwal, waa bàbel làböl lanswà.
Ba bun'bwää kàzak a tsöö, waa bun'tɔ̈ɔ̈l mpà a nsyeenà bàtöŋ ba kun'tswe.
Ba bàsɛmà mukun'pà mbɔr naa: « Mbɔr, mfum a Ayudà! »
Ba bun'kämà un'bii kun'tswe, bun'tsüülà an'te, anà bàbwee an'köm kusà ande ntɔn mukömà.
Ungö amukun'sɛɛ, ba bun'lwom kàzak a tsöö, waa bun'fuur ipfɛy ande. Apan ba bun'twey u nsà a bul ntɔn bàkun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Yɛsu bàmun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi
Mbuur mwɛy, ikɔb ande Simɔn, un'nsi Sirɛn, taar a Alɛksandre anà Rufus, kàfü ndwaŋ, anà kàkäl mulyaaŋ. Aŋità bun'siinà a ngwal musyen kulunsi.
Ba bàsyen Yɛsu kà ikäl mwɛy ikɔb a kya Ngɔlàngɔta, ikaswaŋà naa: « Ikal a köl a un'tswe. »
Ba bun'pɛɛ vin aŋàtüüb a dyam, wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtön munwà la.
Ungö bun'bɛɛrà ba u kulunsi, ba bàkäbà ipfɛy ande, waa bàtɛɛ löb ntɔn muyöb naa mbuur mbuur ininà uwal.
Ba bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi u taaŋ làwà làtutu.
Isin a ndaa bàsön muswaŋ ntsüül a ukwà ande yàkäl abà: « Mfum a Ayudà. »
Ba bàbɛɛrà sye baar abe abɔ̈ɔ̈l u bikulunsi ukɔl a Yɛsu, mwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, umwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ikaar. [
Apan itiir a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yi laa kyàkwe kya: « Nde bun'täŋ unsà ulwaŋ a baar abe. » ]
Baar bàlyaaŋà u mbwo bun'töö, bànii in'tswe, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Imbye itàkal ngye atàman! Ngye awee naa abwiy ndwà a Nzam, waa afàtɔŋ ya kà ilä itär,
tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye, ngye ŋankwo, tɔlà u kulunsi! »
Amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàsɛɛ, ba a ba, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nde kàtsü baar asin mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ nde ukwe anki mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ nde ŋakwo!
Wɛy Klistɔ, mfum a Isàlɛl utɔlà apanà u kulunsi, waa bi iman, waa bi isà làkwikilà! » Baar bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi mbwo mwɛy anà nde, bun'töö sye.
Nkweel a Yɛsu
U midi làpib làkyer abwà u mɛɛn manswà tii u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi.
Apan, u taaŋ làtär, Yɛsu kàsi un'kwɛŋ a ngwal: « Ɛlɔyi, Ɛlɔyi, lɛma sabaktani? » Ikaswaŋà naa: « Nzam a mɛ, Nzam a mɛ, ntɔn nkye aman'wɛy ngye? » -
Bamwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl paa bun'weemà ba, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Làwem, nde kan'bel Ɛli! »

Mbuur mwɛy kàkaamà ntiin, kànwɛmà ikaam a ipfɛy unsà vin a nkyään, nde kàbäm kya u nswɛŋ a un'bii, waa kàsilà kya akà Yɛsu ntɔn nde unü, wàmutɛn naa: « Làdil, bi iler naa nkye Ɛli akyun'tɔɔl u kulunsi! »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsi un'kwɛŋ a ngwal, waa un'swey kàtoo.
Rido a idwà làkaamà itiir byeel fà du tii u ngyɛl.
Kaptɛn kàkäl paa kusà a nde, mpal kàmɛn nde naa nde kàkü aben, waa kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa mbuur wà kàkäl Mwan a Nzam! »
Bàkäl anà akaar amwɛy sye bàleerà ukwɛl. Uboo a ba, bàkäl Màlye un'nsi Magàdala, Màlye ngwän a Zyak Un'kye, anà Yɔsɛ, anà Salɔmɛ.
Ba bàkäl akaar bàyun'labà anà bàyun'syäälà mpal kàkäl nde u Ngalilɛ, anà akaar asin mbɔɔn bàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm anà nde.
Yɛsu bàmusà kà an'dii
Sisye làkäl aŋàbwà, kya kyàkal ilä ayöŋà, iswaŋà naa ilä kyàfweel saba,
un'byääl mwɛy wà làbay a nsaŋ, Yɔsɛfi un'nsi Alimatɛ, kàyàkɔlà paa. Nde sye kàfadilà Imwol a Nzam. Nde kàwɛl ibaal mukyà akà Pilatu ntɔn mulɔm ndom a Yɛsu.
Pilatu kàbem muwem naa nde abwà akwà. Nde kàbel kaptɛn, waa kun'fuul naa nkye nde kàkü itaan.
Ungö kàyöb nde u mbwo a kaptɛn, nde kàpɛ mbwo akà Yɔsefi muwal ndom.
Ungö musom làpye a pɛɛl, nde kàtɔɔl ndom u kulunsi, kàläl ya uboo a làpye, kàsi ya kà an'dii bàfuun uboo a nkɔŋ, waa kàbuum nkɔŋ a kölàköl ntɔn mudübà an'dii.
Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà anà Màlye ngwän a Yɔsɛ bàleerà ikal basi ndom.
